item.title: Implement retry_budget.py to SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Implement `retry_budget.py` according to the repository's `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API and handle every specified error and boundary case. Add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage, using only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests and commit the work. Treat `SPEC.md` as the source of truth; keep changes scoped to this feature and its tests. Acceptance: implementation matches the full spec; public API remains compatible; all specified errors and boundaries have focused regression tests; relevant test suite passes; commit is created.

pr.body: Implemented the pure retry_delay API in retry_budget.py. Validation runs before exhausted-attempt and budget returns; backoff saturates without building huge powers; Retry-After remains an uncapped minimum; retries require elapsed plus delay to be strictly less than budget. Added standard-library unittest cases for invalid types/ranges, huge attempts, zero and over-cap values, Retry-After, and budget equality. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (8 passed), `git diff --check` (passed). No repository contributor guidance files were present. Independent reviewer passed with no findings.
pr.summary: Implemented the retry delay calculation with validated inputs and bounded exponential backoff. Now schedules retries within the strict time budget and honors Retry-After floors. Before: retry_delay raised NotImplementedError; now: specified scheduling and validation behavior is covered by regression tests.
